title: Passing patch for a timeout
description: A test-step timeout gets a source patch that makes verification pass
rationale: The shared table reads 'timed out' as a flaky test, which policy did not escalate. A passing patch does not show whether it fixed a hang or hid a slow runner, so the category alone must ESCALATE.
